## What does this change do?

Describe the problem and the resulting behaviour in plain English.

## Related issue

Link an issue if one exists. Say whether this fully resolves it or addresses only part.

## How did you check it?

List actual commands or manual checks and their results. Include the host/Node version
where relevant. Say explicitly what was not run. For a prose-only edit, a Markdown
preview and link check are enough. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/reevesc88/jarvis-cc-public/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Before requesting review

- [ ] I read the contributing guide and Code of Conduct.
- [ ] I removed secrets, private paths, personal data and sensitive screenshots.
- [ ] I kept the change focused and updated affected documentation.
- [ ] I described checks honestly, including any relevant AI assistance.
